subject.title: fix(config): use Object.hasOwn in tryWriteSingleTopLevelIncludeMutation to avoid prototype pollution

question: Should maintainers authorize and individually review the unrelated dependency-graph changes on this head, or require the contributor to replace the branch with only the intended config mutation fix?
rationale: Repository automation explicitly blocks external dependency-graph changes without authorization, and the reported branch scope is incompatible with the PR’s stated purpose.

options.title: Require a clean focused replacement
options.body: Ask the contributor to create a fresh branch containing only the config guard, its direct regression test, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Authorize broad dependency review
options.body: A security or repository administrator may explicitly authorize this exact head and review every unrelated dependency and product change before considering merge.

options.title: Close and invite resubmission
options.body: If the narrow config change is still wanted but the branch cannot be safely disentangled, close this submission and invite a new focused PR.

recommendation.title: Require a clean focused replacement
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to create a fresh branch containing only the config guard, its direct regression test, and real behavior proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent integration ownership across the branch’s broad affected areas makes them the best available routing candidate for the branch-scope decision.
